header.running_head: Honouring the Household Members of Rasulullaah ﷺ's Family

blocks.text: (RA) did not leave Rasulullaah ﷺ until he had his needs met. When he left, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) asked, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Were you just now afflicted by some illness?" When Rasulullaah ﷺ replied that nothing like that had happened, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) queried, "But I noticed that your voice had become extremely soft." Rasulullaah ﷺ explained, "When Abbaas arrived, Jibra'eel (AS) instructed me to lower my voice as you people have been commanded to lower your voices before me."[^1]

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) reports that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) had a reserved sitting place near Rasulullaah ﷺ which he would forsake for none other than Hadhrat Abbaas (RA). Rasulullaah ﷺ was very much impressed by this gesture of his. When Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) arrived one day, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) moved from his place. "What is the matter?" Rasulullaah ﷺ asked Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). "Your uncle has just arrived," replied Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA). Rasulullaah ﷺ then saw Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) arrive and smiled at Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) saying, "This is Abbaas coming with white clothing. His progeny after him shall soon be wearing black clothing and twelve of them shall be kings."
When Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) arrived, he asked, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Did you say something to Abu Bakr?" "I only told him what is good," Rasulullaah ﷺ remarked. Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) commented, "That is true. May my parents be sacrificed for you! You only speak what is good." Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "I said to him, 'This is Abbaas coming with white clothing. His progeny after him shall soon be wearing black clothing and twelve of them shall be kings.'"[^2]
Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) Vacates his Place for Hadhrat Abbaas (RA)

Hadhrat Ja'far bin Muhammad narrates from his great grandfather that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) always sat on the right of Rasulullaah ﷺ while Hadhrat Umar (RA) sat on his left. Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) sat in front of Rasulullaah ﷺ for he used to write any confidential matters for Rasulullaah ﷺ. However, when Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) came along, Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) would move from his place and Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) would sit there.[^3]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Encourages People to have Love for Hadhrat Abbaas (RA)

Hadhrat Muttalib bin Rabee'ah reports that Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) once came to Rasulullaah ﷺ in a rage. "What is the matter?" Rasulullaah ﷺ enquired. "O Rasulullaah ﷺ!" Hadhrat Abbaas (RA) asked, "What is the problem between us (the Banu Haashim) and the Quraysh?" Rasulullaah ﷺ enquired further, "What has happened between yourself and the Quraysh?" Hadhrat Abbaas (RA)
Ibn Asaakir, as quoted in Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.7 Pg.68).
Tabraani. Haythami (Vol.9 Pg.270) has commented on the chain of narrators. Ibn Asaakir has reported a similar narration in brief, as quoted in Muntakhab Kanzul Ummaal (Vol.5 Pg.211).
